problems.reason: Both sentences state that the holotype is a left ilium from a juvenile individual.
Both sentences give the same age range and stages for the Morrison Formation.
Both sentences refer to fragmentary remains possibly belonging to Stokesosaurus dating to about 152 million years ago.
Sentence 11 classifies Stokesosaurus as a basal member of Tyrannosauroidea, while sentence 12 places it as a derived member of Proceratosauridae.
